children: Columbus McKinnon entered into a First Amendment to its Credit Agreement, refinancing $1.4529 billion of Term Loan B and reducing interest margins on both the term loan and revolving facility by 50 basis points. Existing term lenders could convert cashlessly or be prepaid with proceeds from new and existing lenders. Post-amendment, loans bear interest at term SOFR or base rate plus applicable margins, including 3.00% for Term Loan B and 1.75%–2.75% for dollar SOFR revolver borrowings based on leverage. J.P. Morgan SE was added as administrative agent for EEA borrowers.
: First Amendment to Credit Agreement (refinancing and repricing of Senior Credit Facilities)
: JPMorgan Chase Bank, J.P. Morgan SE and other lenders
: Reduce borrowing costs and enhance financial flexibility
